questions.question: How many grams are in 1 kilogram? Name something with a mass of about 1 g and something of about 1 kg.
questions.expected_answer: 1 kilogram is 1 000 grams. A paper clip has a mass of about 1 g, and a bag of sugar can be 1 kg.

questions.question: On a kitchen scale, numbers go up in 100 g with 4 small marks between them. The pointer is 2 marks past 300. What is the mass? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: The 4 marks make 5 spaces, and 100 divided by 5 is 20, so each mark is 20 g. 2 marks past 300 is 300 plus 40, which is 340 g.

questions.question: Order from lightest to heaviest: 2 kg, 450 g, 1 kg 200 g, 750 g.
questions.expected_answer: Change to grams: 2 000, 450, 1 200 and 750. From lightest to heaviest: 450 g, 750 g, 1 kg 200 g, 2 kg.
